name: Andreas von Bechtolsheim & family

controls.name: Arista Networks, Inc. (co-founder; largest holder)
controls.role: Co-founder; former chairman. Files Form 4s as a 10% owner (not as officer/director) following his 2024 SEC settlement
controls.stake: 183,799,896 shares = 14.6% (183,228,048 held by the Bechtolsheim Family Trust, of which he is trustee; 413,848 direct; 158,000 options)

stakes.name: Alphabet/Google — early $100,000 investment in Google, cited by Forbes as a wealth source (no current share count disclosed)

vehicles.name: Bechtolsheim Family Trust
vehicles.notes: Holds almost all of his Arista shares; he is trustee with sole voting/investment power. Filed Schedule 13G/A on Arista annually through 2024-01-31

privateDeals.what: Arista share sales under a Rule 10b5-1 plan adopted 2026-02-20: 12 Form 4s covering 3,256,848 shares sold 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-17, about $579M (our total from the Form 4 weighted-average prices). Trust held 180,543,048 shares after the 2026-09-17 sales

policy.what: SEC insider-trading settlement (Mar 2024): charged over trading Acacia Communications options before Cisco's 2019 acquisition announcement in accounts of a relative and an associate ($415,726 profits); without admitting or denying, agreed to a five-year bar from serving as officer or director of a public company and a $923,740 civil penalty

watch.what: Continuing Arista sales under the Feb 2026 10b5-1 plan (Form 144s filed roughly every two to three weeks, latest 2026-09-17)
Five-year officer/director bar from the SEC runs to about 2029, so a formal Arista board return can't come before then

gaps: Forbes still lists him as Arista chairman/CDO and gives a stake of 'nearly 17%'. That conflicts with the SEC bar and the 14.6% in the 2026 proxy; the primary filings are used here. No foundation or EIN found (ProPublica search returned nothing). Current Alphabet holding is not disclosed. No reputable reporting on real-estate deals was found. His other angel and startup investments were not researched.
